

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(sctransform)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
counts <- data.table::fread('/nfs/data2/huji_artificial_meat/deconvolution_data/external_sc_references/messmer2023_GSE211428/GSE211428_counts.tsv.gz')
mat <- as.matrix(counts[, -1])
rownames(mat) <- counts$V1

col_meta <- data.table::fread('/nfs/data2/huji_artificial_meat/deconvolution_data/external_sc_references/messmer2023_GSE211428/GSE211428_combined_meta.tsv.gz')
col_meta <- as.data.frame(col_meta)
rownames(col_meta) <- gsub("^(.*)\\.([0-9]+)_([0-9]+)$", "Inj\\3_\\1-\\2", col_meta$Unique_barcode)
col_meta$V1 <- NULL

# make the names path-compatible, since DWLS creates dirs
col_meta$predicted.pheno <- gsub("/", "-", col_meta$predicted.pheno)
gc()

cat("colnames(mat):", length(colnames(mat)), "\n")
cat("col_meta barcodes:", nrow(col_meta), "\n")
cat("Intersection:", length(intersect(colnames(mat), rownames(col_meta))), "\n")
cat("In mat not in col_meta:", length(setdiff(colnames(mat), rownames(col_meta))), "\n")
cat("In col_meta not in mat:", length(setdiff(rownames(col_meta), colnames(mat))), "\n")

common <- intersect(colnames(mat), rownames(col_meta))
mat <- mat[, common]
col_meta <- col_meta[common, ]

messmer2023 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat, meta.data = col_meta)
```

```{r}
unique(messmer2023$predicted.pheno)
```


```{r}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)

filtered <- messmer2023[,messmer2023$predicted.pheno != "Tenocytes"]
seurat_obj <- SCTransform(
  filtered,
  vars.to.regress = c("percent.mt", "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "S.Score", "G2M.Score"),
  verbose = TRUE,
  variable.features.n = 3000,
  vst.flavor = "v2", # set for when matrixStats package errs
)

seurat_obj <- RunPCA(seurat_obj, verbose = FALSE)

set.seed(2023)
seurat_obj <- RunUMAP(seurat_obj, dims = 1:30, verbose = T, n.neighbors = 50, min.dist = 0.1)
seurat_obj$predicted.pheno <- recode(seurat_obj$predicted.pheno, "Monocytes - M?" = "Monocytes / MΦ")
DimPlot(seurat_obj, label = F, group.by = "predicted.pheno", pt.size = 0.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = unname(pals::alphabet(n_distinct(seurat_obj$predicted.pheno))),
                     name = "Cell type") +
  labs(title = "Messmer2023", x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2")
ggsave(filename = "~/artifical_meat_deconv/messmer_counts/Figures/messmer2023_regenerated_umap.png",
       width = 9, height = 6)

# with ellipses around injections
umap_df <- Embeddings(seurat_obj, "umap") %>% as.data.frame()
umap_df$orig.ident <- seurat_obj$orig.ident

DimPlot(seurat_obj, label = T, group.by = "predicted.pheno", repel = T, pt.size = 0.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = unname(pals::alphabet(15)),
                      name = "Cell type") +
  labs(title = "Messmer2023", x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
  stat_ellipse(data = umap_df, aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, group = orig.ident, color = orig.ident),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5)
```
